title: DermoGPT: Open Weights and Open Data for Morphology-Grounded Dermatological Reasoning MLLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating diagnostic accuracy (4-way multiple-choice questions) across different skin tone groups using the Fitzpatrick skin type scale (FST I–V). The paper calculates a specific fairness metric defined as the ratio of the minimum accuracy across any skin tone group to the maximum accuracy across any skin tone group.
